limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime evidence; no independent browser execution was performed.
Each entry groups corresponding normal, enlarged, transition and repeated captures of the named states; transition timing and performance rely on the supplied traces.
The current head is 0a6de9b0; most captures are from a986c44a, with current-head settings visibility supported by the supplied fresh geometry and keyboard checks.
Physical iPhone, Dynamic Type, native keyboard, audible VoiceOver, haptics, native frame rate and operating-system integration remain deferred without deductions solely for that boundary.
Authenticated Circles behavior is unverified because Supabase is unconfigured; the Circles scores apply only to its demonstrated offline and retry states.
Payments are simulated, clipboard and operating-system sharing are mocked, and external fixture destinations establish navigation rather than source credibility or availability.
Synthetic long-form text establishes layout capacity, not production copy quality, model quality or predictive accuracy.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied browser evidence; content crossing a screenshot edge is not treated as inaccessible where runtime evidence establishes scrolling and retrieval.

The authorized threshold is not met: entries containing scores of 8 fall below A>=9 or F>=9 under the specified normalized means; provisional browser scores of 9 do not certify native readiness or repeated novice outcomes.
topFixes: Make populated history and check-in screens more compact through base hierarchy and grouping while retaining full 200% enlargement.
Shorten repeated omen, consent and context explanations so the next action remains visually close to the relevant information.
Improve scanning of long evidence with compact section navigation and clearer source identity/date/action grouping.
Simplify enlarged editor frames and increase usable inline reading space where the viewport permits.
Enlarge ready-screen share previews and add a direct Select link action for clipboard-denied fallback.
Use a more direct, caring sensitive-question heading and consistent written-month reminder dates.
